messages: ivy: Quick note from guerrilla testing — new users expect a clear path on first-run. The empty "Start a project" card just says 'Add sample' and folks hesitate. ben: Seen this. Suggest swapping language to 'Get a starter project' and make the primary action a button. Small visual change, big signal. mira: Also add a tiny inline preview: one screenshot + 2 bullets (what it includes, estimated setup time). Helps people who aren't sure what 'starter' means. ash: Accessibility: ensure the button is tabbable first and provide aria-describedby to the bullets. For preview modal use role="dialog" and focus trap. ivy: Minimal MVP: primary button "Import starter project", inline preview card (screenshot + caption), and a tertiary link "Start from scratch". Track which path users take. ben: Will prototype HTML/CSS. Tiny snippet for a11y alignment: ```html Includes prompts, a demo endpoint, and a quick README. ``` mira: Add alt text for screenshot and ensure contrast ratios. Also localize the CTA copy for non-English locales. onboarding-bot: Task created: PRO-3710 "First-run starter CTA + inline preview MVP" assigned to ivy/ben/mira. Due 2026-04-01. :white_check_mark:
